answer: One workable design: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because cedar only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, thread is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any onyx approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
